rules.section: Article II — Authorized Equity Investment Vehicles
rules.legal_pathway: NYCHA, Preservation Trust, HPD and HUD authority review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: May reuse existing modernization appropriations and reduce parallel administrative structures
rules.redline_template: Add the NYC Public Housing Preservation Trust and successor public entities as eligible co-investment partners only where enforceable resident governance and equity protections are preserved.

rules.section: Article III — Fiscal Architecture and ROI
rules.legal_pathway: Municipal finance, appropriations and federal grant compliance review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: Changes available agency funds, leverage assumptions or long-term public return
rules.redline_template: Update the eligible funding and fiscal-control provisions to prioritize reuse of identified HPD, HRA, NYCHA or HUD resources before requesting new capital, with a documented ROI and non-supplantation finding.

rules.section: Article II — Eligible Buildings and Priority Acquisition
rules.legal_pathway: NYC home rule, due process, property and procurement review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: May redirect recurring enforcement and emergency spending into durable tenant ownership
rules.redline_template: Revise priority-acquisition criteria to incorporate verified distress and enforcement indicators, tenant consent, independent valuation, due process, and a finding that public equity investment offers a superior lifecycle return.

rules.section: Article III — Tenant Eligibility and Cooperative Governance
rules.legal_pathway: NYSHRL, NYCHRL, Fair Housing Act and due-process review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: Reduces litigation and exclusion risk while protecting broad participation in tenant equity
rules.redline_template: Require pre-implementation and annual disparate-impact review of eligibility, screening, data-sharing and governance rules, plus corrective action and an appeal process that preserves access to tenant equity.

rules.section: Article IV — Household Stability and Benefit Coordination
rules.legal_pathway: HRA, HUD and federal-benefit preemption review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: Changes household cash flow, arrears risk and public equity preservation assumptions
rules.redline_template: Create a federal-benefit continuity review and temporary stabilization authority, funded first from permissible existing program resources, when an external policy change materially threatens household cash flow or the public equity position.

rules.section: Article VI — Accountability, Data and Review
rules.legal_pathway: Corporation Counsel review required before implementation
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: May alter litigation exposure, implementation timing or recoverability of public investment
rules.redline_template: Add a legal-change-control clause requiring Corporation Counsel review, documented authority, severability analysis and an implementation hold before applying any affected provision.

rules.section: Article V — Operating-Cost and Resilience Standards
rules.legal_pathway: Building, procurement and federal funding compliance review
rules.fiscal_roi_effect: Changes operating reserves, affordability and lifecycle return
rules.redline_template: Require utility, insurance and climate-risk stress tests and permit cost-effective resilience investment where lifecycle savings protect tenant affordability and the public equity position.
